grid.method: Nearest PNG pixel at each display-cell center in WMS 1.1.1 EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude order. Source RGBA colors are preserved; RGB is not converted to physical measurements. Display-cell size is not native source resolution.
grid.noData: Transparent source pixels remain transparent. White colors are not reclassified as zero or missing: use the source legend. No invented spatial variation or fallback colors.
